title: rhododendron × amoenum var. obtusum
intro: Rhododendron × amoenum var. obtusum, commonly known as the 'Obtuse-leaf' or 'Yunnan Rhododendron', is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the Rhododendron genus, known for its medicinal and ornamental properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of fever, cough, and cold. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron × amoenum var. obtusum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which make it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
